summary: The selected COORD-BOARD-V2-01.7–.11 programme window extends the existing sole owning plan and adds one open Unified Roadmap v3 outcome while preserving finite .1–.6 acceptance and the original nineteen outcome identities. The owning issue's six fields, owning-plan prerequisites, human Status/Roadmap/Track, native execution evidence and derived action-specific decisions have distinct authority. Stable project/schema/repository/native-issue enrollment is separated from fresh issue, dependency, plan, PR/head/check/review, touch-set and capacity observations; board visibility does not enroll work. Existing unambiguous work is continued before duplicate assignment, and non-enrolled in-flight work and uncertain reservations remain constraints. The canonical inspection producer is the handwritten .github CLI/GitHub composition, not the frozen separate importer or copied V1 admission subset. Source preparation is independent of publication, exact installed qualification, admitted idempotent native migration, actual UI verification and coordinated real-use consumer adoption. No source delivery proves active installed identity or UI behavior; duplicate manual v3 current-status maintenance retires only after final cutover acceptance. Product-board contracts and original uncertain operations remain isolated; there is no V1 fallback or new scheduler/operational ledger.
title: V2 programme planning extends the accepted finite pilot through separate cutover gates
